_comment: An intentionally empty overlay. Pass it as CONFIG_LOCAL to suppress the
default one (config.local.json, picked up automatically from beside the
selected config) without deleting or renaming it:
The coverage configs need this. config.local.json normally points
esignet.base_url at a deployed environment, and it is applied on top of
whichever config you name -- so a local coverage run would send its traffic
there while snapshotting the counters of the local instrumented binary, and
report a measurement of a server nothing touched.
CONFIG_LOCAL is required to exist and to parse when set, which is why this is
a real file rather than /dev/null (which is `nul` on Windows and parses as
empty input, not as an empty object).
